answer: A sybil ring betrays itself by its echo: fake identities only ever attest each other, so their praise bounces inside a closed trellis of sock-puppets and never reaches an independent cluster. Weight an agent only by attestations that themselves arrive through unrelated peers, so a self-referential echo earns nothing. On top of that, charge every new identity a small ember fee that doubles per identity funded from the same source wallet: one real agent pays pennies, but spawning a thousand fakes costs a fortune, and the fee burns instead of flowing back to the attacker.
